name: facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craftassist/voxel_models/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_geoscorer_instance: create a Geoscorer instance by providing a merger model path to initialize the ContextSegmentMergerWrapper
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.check_geoscorer_use: check if geoscorer should be used by calling use with steps, repeat_num, and rel_dir parameters
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.produce_segment_position: produce the segment position in context by calling produce_segment_pos_in_context with segment, context, and brc
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.process_voxel_segment: process a sparse voxel segment into an 8x8x8 densified tensor shifted to origin using _process_segment
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.review_geoscorer_blacklist: review the Geoscorer blacklist of unsupported relative directions including BETWEEN, INSIDE, AWAY, and NEAR

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.run_make_seg_ds_cli: run the CLI tool to create a new segmentation dataset from house data and segmentation pickle files
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_id_vocabulary: create a block ID vocabulary by scanning all house schematics and mapping unique block-meta pairs to integers
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.transform_segmentation_data: transform segmentation data items by replacing block-meta pairs with vocabulary IDs using house schematics
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.extract_unique_block_pairs: extract unique block-meta pairs from a house schematic numpy array by iterating over all voxel coordinates
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.load_house_schematic: load a house schematic numpy array from a schematic.npy file in the given house directory

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_schematic_plotter: create a SchematicPlotter instance with a visdom visualization backend for plotting voxel schematics
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.draw_plotly_scatter: use SchematicPlotter drawPlotly to render a 3D scatter plot of voxel data in visdom
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.draw_matplot_3d: use SchematicPlotter drawMatplot to render a 3D matplotlib figure of voxel blocks with Minecraft colors
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.draw_color_hash_visdom: call draw_color_hash to visualize a hash-binned voxel schematic as a colored 3D scatter in visdom
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.plot_cube_at_position: call plotCubeAt to draw a single colored cube at a given 3D position on a matplotlib axis

facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.create_subcomponent_classifier_wrapper: create a SubcomponentClassifierWrapper with an agent, model path, vocab path, and perception frequency
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.run_perceive_on_wrapper: run perceive on the SubcomponentClassifierWrapper to label nearby block objects and store results in memory
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.start_subcomponent_classifier_process: start a SubComponentClassifier process with a voxel model path and vocab path for block recognition
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.recognize_block_objects: recognize a list of tuple blocks using SubComponentClassifier recognize method to get tag labels
facebookresearch_craftassist/python/craf.review_watch_single_object: review the _watch_single_object method to understand how block tuples are converted to location tag pairs
